entry.description: Stop allocating a `Long` per log event in the instant formatting cache used by `%d`. The cache keyed its lookup through a `Function<Instant, Long>`, which boxed the extracted epoch on every call; it now uses a `ToLongFunction<Instant>`. Since the cache is only installed when thread locals are enabled, this allocation happened precisely in garbage-free mode. A failed formatting no longer leaves the cache serving a half-written buffer either.
